title: 第7章阴逼所见略同，蠢逼思路清奇
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

办公室里。

想着刚刚胡天和徐坤的支持。

许景川啧了一声。

这俩倒霉孩子搞得他都有点负罪感了，要是他们知道真相的话，一定会眼泪掉下来吧。

所以也不是欺骗。

更不是自私。

只是单纯不想世界上多两个伤心的人，因此才不能让他们知道真相。

自己可真是善良啊！

许景川都被自己感动了。

“咚咚咚。”突然一阵敲门声打断了他的胡思乱想，随后又传来一道沉闷的声音：“许队长，周组长找您。”

“好，马上过去。”

许景川回了一声。

他能猜到周川找自己干什么。

无非是因为刚刚和谢宏的冲突。

来到周川办公室外。

许景川抬手敲门。

“咚咚咚！”

“请进。”

许景川推门而入，“组长。”

“噢，许队长来了。”周川抖了抖烟灰，笑呵呵的招呼，“随便坐。”

“谢谢组长。”许景川走过去在他对面的椅子上坐下，装傻充愣的问道：“组长叫我来是有事交代？”

“没什么事。”周川丢给许景川一支烟，故作随意的问道：“我听说你跟谢宏发生了点矛盾，动上手了？”

还不等许景川回答，他又叹了口气说道：“说出来不怕你笑话，谢宏是我小舅子，所以……”

“组长我……”许景川装作刚知道这事，脸色骤变，摘了烟就要起身。

“诶，别紧张，坐。”周川温和的安抚他，说道：“事情我了解了，错不在你，在他，我这小舅子从小被家里人给惯坏了，是个不成器的。

没啥本事，性子还倔，让他主动给你道歉是不太可能了，所以我在这里替他跟你说声对不住。”

他态度无奈，语气诚恳。

许景川心里更加警惕了，表面上装出手足无措的样子，“组长，这真不至于，其实我做法也有问题……”

“你没问题！”周川加重语气打断了他的话，笑着摇摇头说道：“要是我手下的人敢违抗命令，还敢拿枪指着我，老子直接当场就崩了他。

你只是打他一顿，没把这事上纲上线按程序办闹大，已经是放他一条生路。

那傻小子不懂，但这个人情我记下了，以后有需要的地方开口。”

如果没有胡天提前警告，加上许景川本就是个生性多疑的人，还真会被周川的言辞和风度给唬住了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the office.

Thinking about the support given by Hu Tian and Xu Kun just now.

Xu Jingchuan clicked his tongue.

These two unlucky children made him feel a little guilty. If they knew the truth, they would definitely shed tears.

So it's not cheating.

It’s not even selfish.

I just don't want two more sad people in the world, so I can't let them know the truth.

You are so kind!

Xu Jingchuan was even moved by himself.

"Dong dong dong." Suddenly a knock on the door interrupted his random thoughts, and then a dull voice came: "Captain Xu, Team Leader Zhou is looking for you."

"Okay, go right away."

Xu Jingchuan replied.

He could guess what Zhou Chuan was looking for.

It was nothing more than the conflict with Xie Hong just now.

Arriving outside Zhou Chuan's office.

Xu Jingchuan raised his hand and knocked on the door.

"Dong dong dong!"

"Please come in."

Xu Jingchuan pushed the door open and said, "Team leader."

"Oh, Captain Xu is here." Zhou Chuan shook the ashes from his cigarette and greeted with a smile, "Sit down wherever you want."

"Thank you, team leader." Xu Jingchuan walked over and sat down on the chair opposite him, pretending to be dumbfounded and asked, "Did the team leader call me here to explain something?"

"It's nothing." Zhou Chuan threw a cigarette to Xu Jingchuan and asked casually, "I heard that you had some conflicts with Xie Hong and started to take action?"

Before Xu Jingchuan could answer, he sighed again and said, "I'm not afraid of making fun of you. Xie Hong is my brother-in-law, so..."

"Team leader, I..." Xu Jingchuan pretended to have just learned about this, his expression suddenly changed, he picked up his cigarette and was about to stand up.

"Hey, don't be nervous, sit down." Zhou Chuan comforted him gently and said, "I understand the matter. The fault is not yours, but his. My brother-in-law has been spoiled by his family since he was a child, and he is ineffective.

It's impossible for him to take the initiative to apologize to you because he has no ability and a stubborn temper, so I'm here to say I'm sorry for him."

His attitude was helpless and his tone was sincere.

Xu Jingchuan became more vigilant in his heart, pretending to be at a loss on the surface, "Team leader, this is really not the case. In fact, there is something wrong with my approach..."

"You have no problem!" Zhou Chuan interrupted him with an emphasis, shook his head with a smile and said: "If one of my men dares to disobey orders and point a gun at me, I will kill him on the spot.

If you just beat him up and didn't make a fuss about the matter, you would have let him live.

That stupid boy didn't understand, but I remembered this favor and will ask for it if needed in the future."

If Hu Tian hadn't warned him in advance and Xu Jingchuan was a suspicious person by nature, he would have been fooled by Zhou Chuan's words and demeanor.
